svg.title: The areas under 1/x squared and 1/x from 1 to b
svg.desc: Left panel: the graph of y = 1/x squared with the region under it from x = 1 to x = b shaded violet. That area is 1 − 1/b: 0.500 at b = 2, 0.900 at b = 10, 0.990 at b = 100, 0.999 at b = 1000. As b grows the area levels off at 1, so the improper integral from 1 to infinity converges to 1. Right panel: the graph of y = 1/x with the region under it from 1 to b shaded vermillion. That area is ln b: 0.693 at b = 2, 2.303 at b = 10, 4.605 at b = 100, 6.908 at b = 1000. It grows without bound, so the improper integral diverges, even though 1/x also approaches 0.

text.tspan: Area from 1 to b: ln b
